527:t_036:3.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「But the mighty $$ゲイツ$$ is different! As long as I have these sideburns, I can keep fighting forever!」

527:t_036:4.en:
$$レド$$
「Is the only way to beat him to drag him out of the cockpit and shave his sideburns?!」

527:t_036:5.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「That is a meaningful suggestion. I judge that engaging him is unnecessary.」

527:t_037:0.en:
$$カレン$$
「Even $$カン・ユー$$ apparently couldn't afford to take his time with parting threats today.」

527:t_037:1.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Even I, an immortal, have to admire his tenacity.」

527:t_038:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
(Wait for me in the afterlife, $$マリリン$$. I'll put an end to all of $$ファイヤバグ$$, including the ones who aren't here.)

527:t_038:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
(Then I'll disappear last, and $$ファイヤバグ$$ will be gone for good.)

527:t_039:1.en:
$$アル$$
「Connecting the barrel extension to the $$デモリッションガン$$ will greatly increase its range.」

527:t_039:2.en:
$$宗介$$
「I never thought an AS would carry a demolition cannon...」

527:t_039:3.en:
$$アル$$
「Transition to $$ガン・ハウザーモード$$ is complete.」

527:t_039:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「...Even being surprised is starting to feel ridiculous.」

527:t_039:5.en:
$$アル$$
「I will take that as a compliment.」

527:t_039:6.en:
$$宗介$$
「This equipment is perfect for us...! We'll master it!」

527:t_100:0.en:
$$宗介$$
(Wait for me, $$千鳥$$...! I'm coming!)

527:t_100:1.en:
$$宗介$$
(Whatever lies ahead, whatever stands in my way, I'll overcome it all to see you!)

527:t_101:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
「You went from an elite special force that completed any mission to a vicious mercenary unit. Now you're $$アマルガム$$'s subcontractors!」

527:t_101:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「You've fallen far, $$ファイヤバグ$$! $$マリリン$$ must be crying in the afterlife!」

527:t_102:0.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「What is that new model?! $$ミスリル$$'s $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$ unit was white and blue!」

527:t_102:1.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Red belongs to the mighty $$ゲイツ$$ and $$シャア・アズナブル$$!!」

527:t_102:2.en:
$$宗介$$
「Is there a reason for the color change?」

527:t_102:3.en:
$$アル$$
「The concept is apparently the color of burning flames.」

527:t_102:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「That's not bad. We'll use it to burn every obstacle to ashes!」

527:t_102:5.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Hey, you! Are you ignoring me, trash collector?!」

527:t_102:7.en:
$$宗介$$
「Then, like a trash collector, I'll gather the garbage and incinerate it!」

527:t_103:0.en:
$$宗介$$
「$$レーバテイン$$... It seems to be a decent machine.」

527:t_103:1.en:
$$アル$$
「You may praise it more frankly.」

527:t_103:2.en:
$$宗介$$
「The AI has a few problems.」

527:t_103:3.en:
$$アル$$
「In that case, it is the operator who exhibits problems.」

527:t_103:4.en:
$$アル$$
「Furthermore, various circumstances prevented this $$レーバテイン$$ from being equipped for electronic warfare.」

527:t_103:7.en:
$$宗介$$
「The operator, AI, and machine are all full of problems.」

527:t_103:8.en:
$$アル$$
「I agree on two of those counts.」

527:t_103:9.en:
$$宗介$$
「But together, we can show our greatest strength! We'll prove it!」

527:t_103:11.en:
$$宗介$$
「Let's do this! Our counterattack starts here!」

527:t_104:0.en:
$$テッサ$$
($$レナード$$... If you're here, I'll make you understand...)

527:t_104:1.en:
$$テッサ$$
(...that no matter what methods or forces you use, people all over the world will never bow to you or the Empire...!)

527:t_105:0.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(The chest laser's convergence adjustment is complete. It can now also be used as a more powerful laser cannon.)

527:t_105:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(I can't simply command from the rear now. I'll master this power too.)

527:t_106:0.en:
$$スザク$$
($$ロイド$$, $$セシル$$... You're fighting for the world too.)

527:t_106:1.en:
$$スザク$$
(The $$アルビオン$$ was upgraded with the data you two prepared...! I'll fight with this power too!)

527:t_107:0.en:
$$カレン$$
(Thank you, $$テッサ$$ and $$ラクシャータ$$! You did a perfect job!)

527:t_107:1.en:
$$カレン$$
(Let's go, $$紅蓮$$! No one can stop us!)

527:t_108:0.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
($$ロイド$$ and $$セシル$$ went and did something unnecessary. With my machine upgraded, I can't slack off in the rear anymore.)

527:t_108:1.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
(...The time really is near... I feel that everything will soon be revealed...)
